name: cad-fond-de-plan
description: Create a metric monochrome architectural Fond de Plan from OSM, Microsoft footprints, and a supplied reference image; export SVG/DXF/PDF/PNG and A3 zooms.

tools.description: Validate CAD/SVG/PNG/PDF deliverable package and report.
Resolve map center, regularize block/road topology, and export SVG plus metric R2018 DXF with layers and multi-sheet paper-space annotations.
Portable underscore-named CLI alias for the read-only A3 layout exporter.
Install and smoke-check the geospatial and CAD dependencies.
Read-only crop of existing Fond de Plan vector geometry to a centered 1:250 A3 landscape SVG/PDF/300-DPI PNG.
